qa_pairs.instruction: What Oracle E-Business Suite versions are supported by the Oracle E-Business Suite driver?
qa_pairs.output: The Oracle E-Business Suite driver supports Oracle E-Business Suite version 12.1.1 and all later releases. The most recent version that is officially supported is Oracle E-Business Suite 12.2.6.

qa_pairs.instruction: Summarize the version support information for the Oracle E-Business Suite driver.
qa_pairs.output: The Oracle E-Business Suite driver works with Oracle E-Business Suite 12.1.1 and any subsequent releases, with the latest supported release being version 12.2.6.
